newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe shares mixed in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe shares mixed in active trade.

text.p: Zimbabwean shares were largely mixed in active trade on Thursday as lower interest rates lured investors from the domestic money market to more lucrative stocks, brokers said.
"The market is still quite bullish. Interest rates have come down and a lot of people are looking for alternative investment in the share market," one broker said.
"We've also had a lot of positive reports about the coming rainy season and that has also boosted trade," he added.

Blue-chip giant Delta and sugar processors ZSR on Thursday traded unchanged at previous levels in reasonable turnover, while 10 cent gains were recorded in Acacia at 240, plate and glass company PGI at 530 and conglomerate TA Holdings at 160.
Hoteliers Zimsun put on 20 cents to 445, tobacco firm TSl added 25 cents to 630 and newspaper group Zimpapers were 50 cents up at 1,850.
The 57-counter industrial index gained 57.40 points to close at a new high of 7,499.90.
In minings, gold miners Falgold and Rio Tinto were unchanged at previous levels as was coal producer Wankie.
There were gains in copper producer Mhangura, which added one cent to 20 and gold firm Ashanti, 100 cents up at 14,100, pushing the seven share index 7.45 points higher to 1,254.16.
